title: Conduct of Proceedings by District Commission

content.scenario: The District Commission is hearing a case where a member is unable to continue the proceeding due to illness. The President and another member are considering how to proceed.
content.outcome: The President and the other member shall continue the proceeding from the stage at which it was last heard by the previous member, as per CPA2019-CH4-S36-1. The proceeding must be conducted by the President and at least one member sitting together.

user_queries: How are proceedings conducted in the District Commission?
What happens if a member is unable to continue a proceeding?
Can the President continue a proceeding alone?
